['Vion Food North GmbH '].company_description: Vion Food North GmbH operates as an international producer of meat, meat products, and plant-based alternatives based in the Netherlands. The company has announced plans to close its northernmost beef slaughterhouse in Germany by the end of July 2023 due to the progressive decline in cattle numbers in northern Germany. Vion is setting up two geographical units - one for Germany and the other for its operations in the Benelux markets.

['POCO Einrichtungsm\u00e4rkte GmbH'].company_description: POCO Einrichtungsmärkte GmbH is a well-known furniture discounter with over 125 stores across Germany. The company employs over 8000 staff and is known for its family-like work environment. POCO offers a wide range of home furnishing products and DIY ideas, and also has a mobile app to keep customers updated on the latest offers and trends.
